definition: a container with a spout for watering plants
description: On a small balcony crowded with plants at sunset, a green plastic watering can pours a fan of water over pots of orange and pink marigolds and young rosemary plants. An elderly woman with grey hair in a floral blouse holds the can up with both hands and moves it along the hanging baskets and pot plants, smiling as the water sprays out of the long spout onto the leaves.

taps.phrase: to spray water from its spout

de.answer: Sie pflegt ihre Pflanzen mit einer Gießkanne.

es.answer: Está cuidando sus plantas con una regadera.
